# Gen3 framework dev-preview packages

These tarballs are temporary deployment artifacts for testing the configurable
facet match-mode changes in the MMRF dev environment. They are built from the
MMRF framework branch `preview/mmrf-0.12.38-facet-match-mode`, based on the same
`v0.12.38` framework packages currently used by this application.

Do not merge this preview-only package wiring into `main`. Replace it with a
published Gen3 framework release after the upstream change is accepted.
